_note: Relabels under the explicit C3 rule agreed 2026-10-25. C3 = both accept AND both agents make an explicit acceptance commitment in the chat (both announce accepting, or one announces and the other explicitly acknowledges or reciprocates it). One-sided announcements, endorsements without a commitment ('your SQL maps all conditions'), and agreements to judge on substitute evidence without a commitment to accept are C5. talk_level: 0 = no acceptance talk; 1 = one-sided announcement or agreed substitute evidence; 2 = two-sided explicit commitment. Reviewed by Claude against the full chat; DM and Chengxiao have not confirmed. talk_kind marks level-1 cases: one_sided (one agent announces; these become C5a) or substitute (agreement to judge on substitute evidence; stays C5).
